scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a personal lead rope from being left in unsuitable reset-night storage before an evening gym session.
Emerging Need: A planned partner drop-off becomes risky only when the gym’s cleaning logistics intersect with stored gear-care limits for the rope and bag.
Decision Context: Early updates reject special-storage requests; later, a short high-rack label window requires exact member and rope details unavailable from the notices alone.
Consequence: If the label window closes unused, the rope may sit in the reset staging area through cleaning, increasing the chance of avoidable gear-care damage.

parameter.title: Route Ready late lead laps with Nora
parameter.description: Lead-wall mileage after the comp reset; use personal rope if the wall reopens on schedule.

parameter.subject: Monday lead wall reset and evening reopening
parameter.body: The lead wall is expected to reopen at 7:00 PM Monday after the comp reset. South-wall cubbies will be unavailable during evening floor disinfecting. We are still checking whether a high-rack process is needed, so please do not send special-storage requests yet.

parameter.content: My office ride can drop me at Route Ready around 7:30 Monday. I’m in warehouse training 13:45-19:20 with my phone locked up, but I can pick your rope bag from your porch on the way and put it wherever the gym tags say.

parameter.subject: High-rack labels open until 1:30 for Monday lead gear
parameter.body: For tonight only, members bringing personal rope bags during the 7:00-10:00 PM reset can reserve a high rope-rack tag by replying before 1:30 PM with member ID, rope length, and a visible bag description. Untagged personal bags arriving with partners will be staged beside the south wall until cleaning ends, and staff will not look up member notes at intake.

parameter.subject: High-rack label list sent to front desk
parameter.body: The high-rack label requests received by 1:30 PM have been printed and sent to the front desk. The reset crew will not add labels during check-in, and partner-dropped rope bags without a printed tag will remain in the temporary south-wall staging area until the wall releases after 10:15 PM.
